rationale: Both Jake and Yin are deeply embedded in robotics — Jake is actively building robot arms in public at Thompson Labs while evangelizing low-level stack optimization, and Yin brings robotics domain expertise plus systems-level technical chops (Lua, Nix) from Stealth Global Robots. Jake's conviction that founders optimizing at the kernel and driver level will win in autonomous systems aligns naturally with someone who understands the technical depth required to ship robotics products.
intro_message: Jake Fitzgerald, meet Yin — you're both operating in robotics and share an appreciation for systems-level technical depth; Yin's background at Stealth Global Robots could offer valuable perspective on what's actually shipping in the space while you build in public.
